comments: The Bka' gdams chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me (ID:6810) lists one “Grong phu lung pa ’Jam dbyang rgyal mtshan” who was a disciple of Ra sa ba Dar ma rgyal mtshan. Dar ma rgyal mtshan was a student of Lha spyil pu ba, and in the same text Lha spyil pu ba is said to have been a disciple of Se spyil ba (W15964 vol.2) 160v5-6 (320:5-6).
name: grang bu lung pa 'jaM dbyangs rgyal mtshan
